items.title_orig: Crazy haul from my local record shop just now!
Which artist do you think is the most anti-RYMcore?
items.article_text:
I mean, which artist is rated lower than you’d normally expect given how they’re generally perceived?
 My first thought is U2, which is quite reasonable considering The Apple Incident, however I feel like their old albums get the hate simply because of the Incident, not because they don't like the music.
 My other thought is Pearl Jam, because among top rated reviews of Ten, there are couple that literally openly claim hating Pearl Jam.
